verdict.rationale: Function execution limits are a fair question for a serverless hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack states CPU-time or wall-clock duration limits for Vercel Functions. The Fluid compute item [vercel-docs-19] describes concurrency scaling, and the Workflows item [vercel-docs-37] describes durable execution, but neither gives timeout or CPU caps that would show whether long-running or agentic workloads fit.
